headline: Brazil sets greenhouse gas emissions monitoring schedule for carbon market starting 2027
summary: Brazil's federal government published Ordinance No. 3,199, establishing a gradual implementation schedule for measurement, reporting, and verification of greenhouse gas emissions in the regulated carbon market starting in 2027.
why: Regulated carbon markets and emissions reporting obligations impose compliance frameworks on heavy industries and shape ESG investing strategies in Latin America.

impacts.name: Brazilian Industrial Sector
impacts.why: Mandatory emissions tracking introduces compliance outlays for domestic industries.
